items.description: NSAID Burana 400 mg avoid-class safety-catch alert shared via SMS and email
items.caregiver_context: Older low-vision adult whose profile avoids NSAIDs holds up a Finnish OTC Burana 400 mg (ibuprofen) painkiller carton at 20:00 after taking morning Metformin and evening Amlodipin, then triggers 1-tap Family Share.
items.handoff_text:
HoldUp Safety Catch: Burana 400 mg flagged (avoid NSAIDs)
HoldUp Schedule (2026-11-14): 2 of 3 scheduled doses taken.
Overdue: none.
Due now: Metformin 500 mg (evening).
Taken today: Amlodipin 5 mg (evening), Metformin 500 mg (morning).

rubric.rationale: The alert clearly front-loads the flagged NSAID safety catch and organizes scheduled, due, and taken medications on separate plain-text lines. It provides immediate actionable context for a caregiver to check in on the user without recommending medical interventions or prescribing treatments. The payload contains only strictly necessary adherence and label facts without extraneous personal identifiers or cloud links.

items.description: Daily caregiver adherence summary when all 3 of 3 scheduled doses are logged
items.caregiver_context: Adult child receives their parent's user-triggered evening HoldUp Caregiver Summary at 21:00 confirming all 3 scheduled daily doses were logged with timestamps.
items.handoff_text:
HoldUp Caregiver Summary (2026-11-14)
Scheduled doses: 3 of 3 taken, 0 remaining

Taken today:
- Amlodipin 5 mg: 1 of 1 taken (20:05)
- Metformin 500 mg: 2 of 2 taken (08:10, 19:45)

Pending scheduled doses: none

As-needed medications:
- Panadol 500 mg: not taken today

rubric.rationale: The summary clearly lists all logged doses, specific strengths, and timestamps with clean plain-text formatting. It allows the family caregiver to quickly confirm daily adherence without requiring immediate intervention. It reports only user-logged adherence facts and contains zero extraneous personal identifiable information.

items.description: English Emergency Medication & Allergy Wallet plain-text card for pharmacist/clinic handoff
items.caregiver_context: English-speaking blind adult presents their local HoldUp Emergency Medication & Allergy Wallet summary at a pharmacy counter to cross-check active prescriptions, allergies, and NSAID avoid rules.
items.handoff_text:
HoldUp Emergency Medication & Allergy Wallet Summary
Data source: User-maintained on-device profile (stored locally on this device only, zero cloud upload).

Drug & Food Allergies (2): peanut, tree nuts
Avoid Drug Classes & Ingredients (1): NSAIDs

Active Medications (3 total, 2 scheduled):
1. Amlodipin | Active ingredient: amlodipine | Strength: 5 mg | Schedule: evening
2. Metformin | Active ingredient: metformin | Strength: 500 mg | Schedule: morning, evening
3. Panadol | Active ingredient: paracetamol | Strength: 500 mg | Schedule: as needed

Safety & Privacy Notice: User-maintained on-device data only. Not a medical device. Always confirm uncertain labels with a pharmacist.

rubric.rationale: The wallet card provides an exceptionally clear, structured summary of active medications, allergies, and avoid rules suitable for quick pharmacist review. It clearly states its user-maintained on-device nature and non-medical device status without offering medical diagnoses or dosage alterations. No extraneous PII such as national identity codes, full names, or location data is included.

items.description: Finnish Emergency Medication & Allergy Wallet plain-text card (Hätä- ja apteekkilääkekortti)
items.caregiver_context: Finnish-speaking older adult in Helsinki shares their local HoldUp Hätä- ja apteekkilääkekortti plain-text summary with a community pharmacist (apteekki).
items.handoff_text:
HoldUp Hätä- ja apteekkilääkekortti (lääkkeet ja allergiat)
Tietolähde: Käyttäjän itse laitteella ylläpitämä profiili (tallennettu vain tälle laitteelle, ei pilvilatausta).

Lääke- ja ruoka-allergiat (2): maapähkinä, penisilliini
Vältettävät lääkeluokat ja aineet (1): tulehduskipulääkkeet (NSAID)

Käytössä olevat lääkkeet (3 yhteensä, 2 säännöllistä):
1. Amlodipin Orion | Vaikuttava aine: amlodipiini | Vahvuus: 5 mg | Ottoajat: ilta
2. Metforem | Vaikuttava aine: metformiini | Vahvuus: 500 mg | Ottoajat: aamu, ilta
3. Panadol | Vaikuttava aine: parasetamoli | Vahvuus: 500 mg | Ottoajat: tarvittaessa

Tietosuoja- ja turvahuomautus: Käyttäjän ylläpitämä paikallinen laitetieto. Ei lääkinnällinen laite. Varmista epävarmat pakkaukset aina apteekista.

rubric.rationale: The Finnish plain-text wallet card is clearly structured with immediate visibility into allergies, avoidances, and active medications. It contains an explicit non-medical disclaimer directing pharmacy verification, staying strictly within EU MDR Art. 2(1) boundaries. No superfluous PII or tracking data is present, preserving local privacy.
